hackathon-security.task: Audit CALA SIGNAL's security and reliability boundaries. Focus on server-only provider secrets, prompt-to-query validation, upstream error handling, rate limiting, redirect/SSRF/XSS risks, Cloudflare runtime compatibility, live Cala latency, and missing adversarial tests. Report only actionable findings with file and line evidence.

launch-readiness.task: Audit CALA SIGNAL as a customer-facing investor sourcing product. Verify that the first screen makes the customer, job, input, output, and reason to trust it immediately clear; hard thesis constraints cannot be promoted when unknown or known to fail; every displayed Cala evidence claim is relevant to the named company and safely linked to its source; provider, repository, security-scan, checkpoint, prompt, token, and development diagnostics remain outside the public product; copy-shortlist and all empty, loading, error, zero-match, and exclusion states are honest and actionable. Also inspect abuse resistance, public response minimization, accessibility, mobile layout, and regression coverage. Report only actionable findings with file and line evidence.
